prompt: 選出正確的答案。
text: Be quiet! The baby _____ in the next room.
options: sleeps
is sleeping
slept
answer: is sleeping

wrong.sleeps: Be quiet! 表示現在正在發生，要用現在進行式，不是習慣用的 sleeps。
wrong.slept: slept 是過去式，但這句話說的是此刻正在睡覺。

why: Be quiet! 暗示現在進行中的動作，用 is sleeping。
tip: 現在正在做，用 be + V-ing。
say: The baby is sleeping in the next room.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: They are play basketball in the park.
They are playing basketball in the park.
They playing basketball in the park.
answer: They are playing basketball in the park.

are 後面的動詞要加 -ing，變成 playing。
進行式需要 be 動詞，少了 are 句子不完整。

why: 現在進行式的結構是 be 動詞 + 動詞-ing。
tip: 進行式缺一不可：be 動詞加 V-ing。
say: They are playing basketball in the park.

prompt: 遊客問你郵局怎麼走，你想說「沿著這條街直走，然後在銀行轉右」，哪一句最清楚？
options: Go straight along this street and turn right at the bank.
Go straight across this street and turn left at the bank.
Walk this street and turn right to the bank at.
answer: Go straight along this street and turn right at the bank.

wrong.Go straight across this street and turn: across 是「穿越」，不是沿著；left 是左轉，和題目的右轉不一致。
wrong.Walk this street and turn right to the b: walk 後面缺少 along，而且 at the bank 的位置顛倒，語序不正確。

why: along 表示沿著，turn right at 表示在某處右轉。
tip: 沿著走 along，轉彎 turn right at。
say: Go straight along this street and turn right at the bank.

prompt: 選出適合的介系詞。
text: The bus stop is _____ the post office and the bakery.
options: between
among
behind
answer: between

wrong.among: among 用在三者以上的中間；這裡只有郵局和麵包店兩個地方，要用 between。
wrong.behind: behind 是「在後面」，與題意「在兩者之間」不同。

why: 兩個地點的中間用 between。
tip: 兩者之間 between，三者以上 among。
say: The bus stop is between the post office and the bakery.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I was watching TV when my mom come home.
I was watching TV when my mom came home.
I watching TV when my mom came home.
answer: I was watching TV when my mom came home.

when 後面說的是過去發生的事，come 要改成過去式 came。
過去進行式需要 was，少了 was 不完整。

why: 過去持續的動作用 was watching，被打斷的短動作用過去式 came。
tip: 長動作用過去進行，打斷它的用過去式。
say: I was watching TV when my mom came home.

prompt: 朋友問你昨天去了哪裡，你想說「我去了圖書館」，哪一句最自然？
options: I go to the library yesterday.
I went to the library yesterday.
I was go to the library yesterday.
answer: I went to the library yesterday.

yesterday 表示過去，go 要改成過去式 went。
was 和 go 不能放在一起；過去式 went 已經足夠。

why: yesterday 是過去的時間，go 的過去式是 went。
tip: go 的過去式是 went，不加 ed。
say: I went to the library yesterday.

prompt: 選出正確的答案。
text: You _____ wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
options: ought to
ought
are ought to
answer: ought to

wrong.ought: ought 後面一定要接 to，再接原形動詞。
wrong.are ought to: ought to 本身是助動詞，前面不能再加 be 動詞 are。

why: ought to 表示「應該」，後面接原形動詞。
tip: ought to ＝ 應該，後面接原形動詞。
say: You ought to wear a helmet when you ride a bike.

prompt: 這句話的意思是什麼？
text: Let's meet at the ticket office at six.
options: 我們六點在售票處碰面吧
我們六點去買票
我們六點離開電影院
answer: 我們六點在售票處碰面吧

wrong.我們六點去買票: 句中 meet 是「碰面」，不是 buy tickets（買票）。
wrong.我們六點離開電影院: at the ticket office 是在售票處，沒有說要離開。

why: Let's meet at 是約定在某處碰面，ticket office 是售票處。
tip: Let's meet at ＋地點，就是約碰面。
say: Let's meet at the ticket office at six.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: How much is these apples?
How much are these apples?
How many are these apples?
answer: How much are these apples?

wrong.How much is these apples?: these apples 是複數，be 動詞要用 are，不是 is。
wrong.How many are these apples?: 問價錢要用 How much，How many 是問數量。

why: 問價錢用 How much，主詞複數時搭配 are。
tip: 問價錢用 How much，數量用 How many。
say: How much are these apples?

prompt: 你在車站不確定該不該在下個轉角右轉，想請路人確認，哪一句最自然？
options: Should I turn right at the next corner?
I should turn right at the next corner?
Do I should turn right at the next corner?
answer: Should I turn right at the next corner?

wrong.I should turn right at the next corner?: 疑問句要把 should 移到主詞前面，不能只改語調。
wrong.Do I should turn right at the next corne: should 本身是助動詞，不需要再加 do。

why: 助動詞疑問句把 should 放在句首。
tip: 助動詞問句：should 放最前面。
say: Should I turn right at the next corner?

prompt: 選出適合的詞。
text: Lucy gets sick on boats, so she never travels _____ ship.
options: by
on
with
answer: by

wrong.on: on 不能直接這樣搭配交通工具；表示搭乘方式要用 by。
wrong.with: with 是「和、用」，不是表示搭乘什麼交通工具。

why: by + 交通工具（不加冠詞）表示搭乘方式。
tip: by plane、by bus，by 後不加 a。
say: She never travels by ship.

prompt: Which word means 「星期四」？
text: We have a swimming lesson on Thursday.
options: Thursday
Tuesday
Saturday
answer: Thursday

wrong.Tuesday: Tuesday 是星期二，拼法和 Thursday 很像，要仔細區分。
wrong.Saturday: Saturday 是星期六，不是星期四。

why: Thursday 是星期四，Tuesday 是星期二。
tip: Thursday 四、Tuesday 二，別搞混。
say: We have a swimming lesson on Thursday.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: What did you doing last night?
What did you do last night?
What do you did last night?
answer: What did you do last night?

wrong.What did you doing last night?: did 後面要接原形動詞 do，不能加 -ing。
wrong.What do you did last night?: 過去式問句只用一個過去助動詞 did，do 和 did 不能同時用。

why: 過去式疑問句是 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
tip: did 開頭的問句，動詞用原形。
say: What did you do last night?

prompt: 鄰居的行李很重，你想主動幫忙，哪一句最合適？
options: Do you want help?
Can I give you a hand?
You must give me your bag.
answer: Can I give you a hand?

wrong.Do you want help?: 句子文法沒錯，但聽起來有點生硬，不像日常幫忙的禮貌說法。
must 是命令語氣，很不客氣，對方沒有答應就要求拿東西。

why: Can I give you a hand? 是自然又有禮貌的主動幫忙說法。
tip: 主動幫忙：Can I give you a hand?
say: Can I give you a hand?

prompt: 選出正確的答案。
text: There _____ a lot of people at the night market last Saturday.
options: is
were
are
answer: were

wrong.is: last Saturday 是過去，且 a lot of people 是複數，is 兩者都不合。
wrong.are: are 是現在式；last Saturday 說的是過去，要用 were。

why: people 是複數且時間是過去，there were 才對。
tip: 過去複數用 there were。
say: There were a lot of people at the night market last Saturday.

prompt: 這句話表示什麼？
text: Luckily, my brother brought a rechargeable lamp, so I could keep studying.
options: 哥哥帶了檯燈，我才能繼續念書
哥哥把燈弄壞，我不能念書
我替哥哥買了一盞檯燈
answer: 哥哥帶了檯燈，我才能繼續念書

wrong.哥哥把燈弄壞，我不能念書: Luckily 表示幸運，後面是好結果，不是燈壞了。
wrong.我替哥哥買了一盞檯燈: 句中是 my brother brought，帶燈的人是哥哥，不是我。

why: Luckily 引出好結果：哥哥帶燈，所以我可以繼續念書。
tip: so 表示結果，Luckily 表示幸好。
say: Luckily, my brother brought a rechargeable lamp.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: She is more tall than her sister.
She is taller than her sister.
She is tallest than her sister.
answer: She is taller than her sister.

tall 是短形容詞，比較級直接加 -er，不用 more。
tallest 是最高級，前面要有 the；兩者比較要用 taller than。

why: 短形容詞的比較級加 -er，後面接 than。
tip: 兩者比較：形容詞加 -er + than。
say: She is taller than her sister.

prompt: 你想問路人最近的便利商店怎麼走，哪一句最自然？
options: Excuse me, where is the nearest convenience store?
Hey, where the convenience store near is?
Excuse me, what convenience store is nearest where?
answer: Excuse me, where is the nearest convenience store?

wrong.Hey, where the convenience store near is: hey 不夠禮貌，而且語序錯誤，疑問詞後面應是 is the nearest ...。
wrong.Excuse me, what convenience store is nea: what 和 where 重複，句子結構混亂，聽不懂。

why: Excuse me 開場，where is + 地點，是禮貌問路的標準句型。
tip: 問路：Excuse me, where is ...?
say: Excuse me, where is the nearest convenience store?

prompt: 選出適合的副詞。
text: I _____ visit my grandparents on weekends. We have dinner together every week.
options: regularly
rarely
hardly
answer: regularly

wrong.rarely: rarely 是「很少」，與 every week（每週）的意思相反。
wrong.hardly: hardly 是「幾乎不」，不符合每週都見面的情況。

why: every week 表示固定、規律，所以用 regularly。
tip: regularly ＝ 規律地、定期地。
say: I regularly visit my grandparents on weekends.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The children is singing in the music room.
The children are singing in the music room.
The children singing are in the music room.
answer: The children are singing in the music room.

wrong.The children is singing in the music roo: children 是 child 的複數，be 動詞要用 are。
wrong.The children singing are in the music ro: 這句語序變成「唱歌的孩子在音樂教室」，和原本想表達的進行動作不同，且不自然。

why: children 是複數，現在進行式用 are singing。
tip: children 是複數，搭配 are。
say: The children are singing in the music room.

prompt: 下面哪個字的意思是「商店」？
text: My aunt works in a small shop near the station.
options: shop
ship
sheep
answer: shop

wrong.ship: ship 是「船」，和 shop 只差一個母音，拼字很像。
wrong.sheep: sheep 是「綿羊」，發音和意思都不同。

why: shop 是商店，句中 works in a small shop 是在小商店工作。
tip: shop 商店，ship 船，別拼錯。
say: My aunt works in a small shop near the station.

prompt: 選出正確的答案。
text: Please be careful. Don't _____ the street when the light is red.
options: cross
crossing
to cross
answer: cross

wrong.crossing: Don't 後面要接原形動詞，不是動詞-ing。
wrong.to cross: 助動詞 do 的否定後面不加 to，直接接原形。

why: Don't 後面接原形動詞，形成否定的命令句。
tip: Don't 後面接原形動詞。
say: Don't cross the street when the light is red.

prompt: 朋友邀你週六一起去公園，你已經有約，想委婉拒絕，哪一句最合適？
options: No. I don't want to go.
Sorry, I can't. I have a piano lesson.
I won't go. Don't ask me again.
answer: Sorry, I can't. I have a piano lesson.

文法沒錯，但太直接，沒有道歉也沒有理由，聽起來冷淡。
語氣很兇，會讓朋友覺得被拒絕得很不舒服。

why: 先道歉再說理由，是禮貌拒絕邀請的方式。
tip: 拒絕邀請：Sorry, I can't. 加理由。
say: Sorry, I can't. I have a piano lesson.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: How did you pay for the ticket? I pay by credit card.
How did you pay for the ticket? I paid by credit card.
How do you paid for the ticket? I paid by credit card.
answer: How did you pay for the ticket? I paid by credit card.

wrong.How did you pay for the ticket? I pay by: 問的是過去的事，回答也要用過去式 paid。
wrong.How do you paid for the ticket? I paid b: 問句用了 do 又用 paid，時態重複；did 後面動詞要用原形 pay。

why: 問句用 did + 原形 pay，回答用過去式 paid。
tip: pay 的過去式是 paid，不是 payed。
say: I paid by credit card.

prompt: 選出適合的字。
text: The school fair was great, and we had a lot of fun _____.
options: together
each other
other
answer: together

wrong.each other: each other 是「彼此」，是代名詞，不能放在句尾當副詞「一起」。
wrong.other: other 是「其他的」，不能這樣單獨表示「一起」。

why: together 是副詞，表示「一起」，放在句尾自然。
tip: 一起做事用 together。
say: We had a lot of fun together.

prompt: 這位同學想表達什麼？
text: Can you hold the door for me, please?
options: 請你幫我扶住門
請你把門鎖起來
請你幫我買門票
answer: 請你幫我扶住門

wrong.請你把門鎖起來: hold the door 是扶住門，不是 lock the door（鎖門）。
wrong.請你幫我買門票: door 是門，ticket 才是票，兩者不同。

why: hold the door 是扶著門別讓它關上。
tip: hold the door ＝ 扶住門。
say: Can you hold the door for me, please?

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: We went to the museum by walking last Sunday.
We walked to the museum last Sunday.
We walk to the museum last Sunday.
answer: We walked to the museum last Sunday.

wrong.We went to the museum by walking last Su: 文法可以通，但不自然；走路去直接說 walked to 就好。
last Sunday 是過去，walk 要改成過去式 walked。

why: 過去的事用過去式 walked，句子簡潔自然。
tip: 規則動詞過去式加 -ed。
say: We walked to the museum last Sunday.

prompt: 同學說他忘了帶水壺，你想問他要不要分你的水，哪一句最自然？
options: Would you like some of my water?
Do you want some my water?
You drink my water, okay?
answer: Would you like some of my water?

wrong.Do you want some my water?: some 和 my 之間要加 of，some of my water 才完整。
wrong.You drink my water, okay?: 像命令別人喝水，語氣不自然也不禮貌。

why: Would you like ... 是禮貌提供東西的說法，some of 後接所有格。
tip: 提供東西：Would you like ...?
say: Would you like some of my water?

prompt: 選出最合適的答案。
text: My neighbors and I _____ planting trees in the community garden now.
options: are
is
was
answer: are

wrong.is: my neighbors and I 是複數，不能用單數的 is。
wrong.was: now 表示現在，was 是過去式，時間不合。

why: 主詞複數、時間是現在，現在進行式用 are planting。
tip: now 搭配 be 動詞 + V-ing。
say: My neighbors and I are planting trees in the community garden now.
